name: Girona-Costa Brava Airport

hours.v: Airport 24 hours; ATS, fuel and handling during airport hours

customs.v: Customs and immigration during airport hours (airport is H24)

slots.v: Slot needed; request it with PPR at least 3 hours ahead to CECOA LEGE; no flights without clearance
slots.quote: Request slot PPR 3 HR to CECOA LEGE.

ppr.v: PPR 3 hours with the slot request
ppr.quote: Request slot PPR 3 HR to CECOA LEGE.

handling.v: Handling agent mandatory for all operations, private flights included
handling.quote: It is mandatory to have handling agent for all operations, non-commercial operations included

fuel.v: Jet A-1 and 100LL during airport hours

notes: Read AIP España AD 2-LEGE (HTML). The page shows WEF 16 Apr 2026, older than the 29 Oct 2026 cycle; it was the page served as current. Customs is 'HR AD' and the airport is H24, so customs follows the 24-hour airport. Business aviation is subject to declared capacity. No night curfew stated.
